patterns.note: Content is presented within a centered, constrained-width column, providing ample horizontal padding on larger screens for a focused reading experience.
Large, bold sans-serif headings establish clear hierarchy for sections, contrasting with a lighter weight sans-serif for body text and a distinct monospaced font for code examples.
A high-contrast palette features a stark white background, dark gray text for readability, and a vibrant blue (#0a82f5) consistently used for calls-to-action and interactive elements.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, providing persistent access to key site links.
Major content blocks are separated by generous vertical whitespace, creating distinct sections that are easy to scan and digest.

technique_notes: A full-width header contains a sticky navigation bar that maintains its position at the top of the viewport during scroll, ensuring constant access to site links.
The hero section features a prominent video player embedded within a stylized code editor interface, serving as a dynamic visual demonstration of the product's functionality (video-hero).
Content sections utilize a centered, constrained width layout for readability, with headings, paragraphs, and code block elements clearly structured to guide the user through technical explanations.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) create strong hierarchy, complemented by a readable body text size and smaller, uppercase navigation labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently applied to buttons, the video player, and overall UI elements, contributing to a precise, technical feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with significant vertical spacing between major content sections and paragraphs, enhancing readability and giving elements room to breathe.

standout: The site's distinctive blend of a clean, almost minimal marketing page aesthetic with deeply technical content, prominently featuring a code-editor-style video hero and a classic, hand-drawn illustration. It manages to convey a serious, developer-focused product without resorting to overly complex or flashy design.
